method: Deterministic audit of explicitly authored hops and separately displayed two-hop exact identity/ownership/role context. No fuzzy names, inferred cash hops, shared-address joins, new adverse claims or amount totals.
limitation: Retained context keeps its original source review date. Source-family labels describe provenance grouping, not a guarantee of independent corroboration. A stopped path does not prove there was no further transfer.
